product_metadata.title: mDesign Small Plastic Disposable Paper Cup Dispenser - Compact Storage Holder for Mouthwash Cups on Bathroom Vanity Countertops, 3 oz. Rinsing Cups Included - Lumiere Collection - Clear
features: A DISPENSER FOR EVERY SINK: Place dispensers next to sinks in every bathroom throughout your home; Perfect for guest bathrooms, half baths, powder rooms, and the master bathroom; Ideal for the family or kid's bathroom; Disposable plastic or paper cups will always be ready when you need a sip of water, mouthwash, or for rinsing after brushing teeth

CONVENIENTLY SIZED: Fits perfectly on bathroom vanities and countertops; Small enough for pedestal sinks; The mini cups in this organizer are just the right size for rinsing your mouth after brushing or providing just enough water to wash down aspirin, vitamins, supplements and other pills; Keep in a medicine cabinet for more discreet storage; The petite size is perfect for home, apartments, condos, RVs, campers and cabins; Ideal for small space living and tiny homes

FUNCTIONAL & VERSATILE: The cut-away front and open top make it easy to grab a cup; Ready to use - each dispenser arrives with 14 blue paper cups; Open front allows you to easily see when it is time for a refill; This cup holder can also be used to store cotton makeup rounds or disposable makeup remover wipes
QUALITY CONSTRUCTION: Made of durable plastic; The disposable rinsing cups are made of paper; Easy Care - Clean with mild soap and water; Do not place in dishwasher
THOUGHTFULLY SIZED: Measures 3.05" diameter x 5" high; Holds 3 oz. / 88.7 mL cups
